rust_summary: scaled GUI text (`native_text_scaled`), as a pose `scale` draws it.
doc_summary: `native_text_scaled(batch, text, at, scale, argb, shadow)` draws a line of text with its top left at `at`, `scale` times its size (a pose `translate(at)`, `scale(scale)`: the shadow offset grows too), in `argb` (an alpha under 4 reads as opaque), and returns the scaled width in GUI pixels. A `scale` that is not finite and positive draws nothing. It scales the glyph quads it just pushed, so the cost is that of `native_text`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:text_scaled@.
